technical.summary: Mixed signals with long-term trend support (50/200 SMA bullish) but conflicting short-term price positioning (below key EMAs) and overbought stochastic RSI suggest caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, with elevated earnings risk in 119 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (348.8), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and imminent CPI event in 2 days create hostile trading environment despite low near-term earnings risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 50/200 bullish crossover with supertrend and hull confirmation provides long-term trend support, and extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) presents classic contrarian buy opportunity near support level 442.21.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below both EMA 9/21 and SMA 50/200 contradicts bullish technicals, stochastic RSI overbought signals imminent pullback, macro environment hostile (VIX 348.8, flat yield curve, CPI event in 2 days), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While SMA 50/200 bullish structure and extreme fear sentiment present contrarian appeal, price trading below both EMA 9/21 and SMA 50/200 creates immediate technical contradiction, and hostile macro environment (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, CPI in 2 days) makes swing entry timing poor.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent CPI event in 2 days combined with VIX in crisis territory (348.8) creates binary event risk that could trigger sharp reversal below support 442.21, invalidating technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 36 positions in Consumer Staples sector; adding COST increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money conviction to justify it.
